battle.name: 洛陽、虎牢之戰
battle.brief: 武德三年七月，高祖詔李世民率軍東征，環攻鄭王王世充之洛陽，蠶食近城州鎮、斷其糧道；明年竇建德率十餘萬眾西來救鄭，兩軍相持虎牢兩月。五月唐軍夜襲，板渚野戰破夏軍，竇建德被擒，王世充遂獻城降唐。卡面兵器秦連弩，正是虎牢關與洛陽城頭壓制攻城者的守方利器。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭是唐初平定中原的一場會戰，交戰三方都是隋末群雄留下的政權。唐是李淵在關中與河東建立起來的帝國，以關隴軍事集團為骨幹，用府兵制從縣戶抽調兵丁，關中的屯田與蜀中的漕運供給糧秣，李世民、李元吉所率的秦王府精兵則是全軍最硬的鋒刃，唐廷能自長安出師、東征數月而軍心不散，靠的就是這套體系。鄭是王世充在洛陽建立的政權，憑洛陽城垣、河南倉儲與四鄰州郡立國，四面受敵而城守堅固，糧道一被切斷便迅速凋敝。夏是竇建德在河北整合起來的政權，控弦之士以數十萬計，盡有冀、兗、豫北之地，馬匹、屯田與河北的人丁是其真正的立國之資，兩家往來通使時王世充以竇建德為夏公。局外的勢力同樣在動：劉黑闥收拾竇建德遺下的河北地盤，劉武周、梁師都與突厥諸部在北面與西面牽制唐軍，使唐廷無法傾國力一次押上東線；虎牢關與洛陽之間這片平原，就成了唐、鄭、夏三家的決勝之地。
countriesEn: This war was a set-piece battle for the settlement of the central plain in the early Tang, and all three belligerents were regimes grown out of the Sui collapse. The Tang was the empire Li Yuan had established in Guanzhong and Hedong: its backbone was the Guanzhong military group, it drew its soldiers from the county registers through the fubing system, and it fed its armies from the garrison fields of Guanzhong and the grain shipped by river from Shu, while the picked troops of the Prince of Qin establishment under Li Shimin and Li Yuanji were the hardest of its edges; it was this system that let the court march east from Chang'an and fight for months without the army falling apart. Zheng was the regime Wang Shichong had raised at Luoyang, resting on the city walls, the storehouses of Henan and the surrounding prefectures: strong in defence, beset on every side, and quick to wither once its grain road was cut. Xia was the regime Dou Jiande had knitted together in Hebei, with several hundred thousand men under arms, holding the greater part of Ji, Yan and northern Yu; its horses, its garrison fields and the manpower of Hebei were its real foundation, and when the two sides exchanged envoys Wang Shichong styled Dou Jiande the Duke of Xia. Powers outside the three were moving too: Liu Heita was picking up what Dou Jiande had left behind in Hebei, while Liu Wuzhou, Liang Shidu and the Turkic tribes held the Tang down in the north and the west, so that the court could never commit the whole realm to the eastern front; the plain between Hulao and Luoyang thus became the field of decision for Tang, Zheng and Xia alike.
people: 全場有兩位主角。李世民，李淵次子，武德元年淺水原破薛舉、武德二年破宋金剛，兵威及於關中；洛陽城下他做的是圍城斷糧、待敵自敝，虎牢關外的板渚，他用牧馬誘敵、夜間還軍的辦法把竇建德十餘萬眾引出營地，再以三千鐵騎直搗中軍，一戰而定。竇建德，河北武城人，隋末起兵，武德元年併張金稱部眾，逐步平定河北諸部，兵眾號稱百萬，武德三年進位夏王於樂壽；他肯聽凌敬之謀，惜乎諸將不從，終因眾心已散而在板渚被擒。鄭主王世充最為被動：他不斷遣使求救，卻不肯在援軍到來之前冒死出城合擊，援軍覆滅後立刻獻城。勸竇建德出兵的是中書侍郎劉彬；唐廷留李元吉、屈突通繼續圍城，諜報往來都靠這些人。竇建德死後，部將劉黑闥半年之間收復河北故地，武德六年才由李建成平定，這條尾巴把本役的餘波拖到三年之後。
peopleEn: Two men dominate the whole campaign. Li Shimin, the second son of Li Yuan, had broken Xue Ju at Qianshuiyuan in the first year of Wude and Song Jingang in the second, and his fame had reached as far as Guanzhong; before Luoyang his method was to blockade the city, cut the grain road and wait for the enemy to tire of itself, while at Banbu outside Hulao Pass he used the device of grazing horses to draw the enemy out and of returning by night to spring the trap, luring Dou Jiande's host of more than a hundred thousand out of its camp, and then drove three thousand armoured riders straight into the middle of the enemy, settling the whole affair in a single stroke. Dou Jiande, a native of Wucheng in Hebei, rose in arms at the end of the Sui, absorbed Zhang Kecheng's following in the first year of Wude and gradually brought the other Hebei warlords under control until he could claim a hundred thousand men under arms; in the third year of Wude he advanced to the title of Prince of Xia at Leshou. He was a man who listened to the counsel of Ling Jing, and it was the other generals who refused it; in the end, with the will of his troops already broken, he was taken prisoner at Banbu. Wang Shichong, the ruler of Zheng, was the most passive of the three: he sent envoys begging for help again and again, yet would not risk a sortie to join his relief army before it arrived, and once that army was destroyed he surrendered the city on the spot. The official who persuaded Dou Jiande to send help was Liu Bin, a secretary of the secretariat; on the Tang side Li Yuanji and Qutu Tong were left to keep the siege of Luoyang, and the intelligence on which everything depended passed through hands such as these. After Dou Jiande's death his old troops set up Liu Heita, who recovered Dou's former territory in Hebei within half a year, and it was not until the sixth year of Wude that Li Jiancheng finally destroyed him; that loose end carried the aftermath of this campaign three years beyond it.
kits: 卡面兵器是秦連弩，形製早於本役八百餘年。弩機把弦拉力存起來，張弦扣機之後不必再拉弓，一踩一發，射速遠勝拉弓；守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。連弩之名的明確記載要到漢末三國，《三國志·蜀書·諸葛亮傳》有「損益連弩」一語，弩機的考古標本則以戰國至漢代最為常見；到了隋末唐初，實戰中的弩手分為蹶張、臂張、床弩諸式，《通典·兵典》分列其制，機括的原理一脈相承，只是批量與射程各有增益。本役最能發揮連弩作用的地方，正是虎牢關與洛陽城頭：虎牢是崤山南北的隘口，關城狹長，車不能前、馬不能展開，唐軍只能先以小股步騎試探，再以弩箭壓住關前的通道，逼得追兵不敢貼關；洛陽四面城郭，衛城者以城頭弩列與長槊手構成常設火力，攻城者一旦貼上女牆便再無退路。與此同時，唐、鄭、夏三軍的裝備仍以唐制武備為主：長兵器有馬槊、步槊與陌刀，弓弩之外還有穿甲箭、毒箭與火油火箭，攻城用雲梯、巢車、撞車、穴車與飛石，守城則備礌石、拒馬、鹿角與沸油；馬匹上，夏軍靠河北之馬，唐軍靠關中與河東的牧場，兩軍的勝負，最後仍決於誰能把糧秣送到前線。
kitsEn: The card face is the Qin repeating crossbow, a mechanism whose form dates from more than eight hundred years before this war. The trigger mechanism stores the strain of the string: once the bow is drawn and the latch set, the archer need not pull again, and a single stroke of the foot releases one bolt, so the rate of fire far exceeds that of the bow; it is the side that holds the walls that uses it to keep the attackers pinned outside. A clear written name for the repeating crossbow only appears in the late Han and the Three Kingdoms, for the biography of Zhuge Liang in the Records of the Three Kingdoms speaks of altering the repeating crossbow, while the archaeological specimens of the mechanism are commonest from the Warring States to the Han; by the end of the Sui and the opening of the Tang the crossbowmen of the field armies were divided into the pedal-drawn, the arm-drawn and the bed crossbow, and the Canon of the Tiantai Records sets out their several forms, the principle of the latch unchanged though the rate of fire and the range were each improved. The places in this campaign where the repeating crossbow did most work were exactly Hulao Pass and the walls of Luoyang. Hulao was the defile by which the Xia and Song ranges of mountains run north and south, its pass-fortress long and narrow, where no cart could advance and no horse could deploy; the Tang army could only probe forward with small bodies of foot and horse, and then hold the ground before the pass with bolt fire, so that the pursuers dared not close on the gate. Luoyang, ringed on four sides by its city walls, was defended by standing bolt lines on the ramparts and by men with long thrusting spears, and an attacker once glued to the parapet had nowhere left to retreat. All the same, the equipment of the three armies remained Tang-style throughout: long arms of the cavalry lance, the foot lance and the pao-dao, and besides bows and crossbows the armour-piercing bolt, the poisoned bolt and the fire-lashing rocket, with scaling ladders, mobile sheds, battering rams, mining cars and stone-throwing engines against the walls, and stones, cheval-de-frise, spiked abatis and boiling oil in their defence. As to horses, the Xia drew theirs from Hebei and the Tang from the pastures of Guanzhong and Hedong; and the issue between the two armies was settled, in the end, by who could get the grain to the front.
tactics: 唐軍的戰法是典型的圍點打援。李淵取先鄭後夏、各個擊破之策，武德三年七月命李世民率軍東征，先取慈澗，再蠶食洛陽近處州鎮，切斷糧道，兵鋒駐在北邙山；次年三月合圍洛陽，挖溝築壘，把鄭軍困在城中。竇建德不能坐視，遂率十餘萬眾西進，沿途打下周橋、管州、滎陽、陽翟，卻因所取皆為空城與殘縣而延誤了時日。李世民自領一軍趣虎牢，兩軍相持兩月有餘，夏軍糧援不繼，士氣先崩。國子祭酒凌敬獻策，主張渡黃河取懷州、河陽，翻太行入上黨，攻汾陽、太原，下蒲津，既可入虛地，又可拓地募兵，還能震動關中；曹皇后亦贊同，諸將卻以深入為險而阻之，竇建德終未採行，一場主動的北伐就此胎死腹中。及唐軍糧草將盡、夏軍牧馬河北岸，李世民北渡黃河至廣武，留千餘匹馬在河邊放牧以誘敵，當夜還軍虎牢；竇建德果中計，全軍自板渚西出，正面寬達二十里，擂鼓挑戰。世民按兵不動，只以少量兵力糾纏，日中夏軍饑疲思歸，皆坐列爭水，秩序大亂，唐軍乃以三千鐵騎直衝其營，竇建德正與群臣議事，陣勢驟然崩解，追奔三十里而擒之。守城的鄭軍則自始倚靠虎牢關與洛陽城頭的弩列，援軍既沒，糧道又斷，數月之後只得開城。
tacticsEn: The Tang method was the classic one of besieging a point in order to strike at relief. Li Yuan took the strategy of dealing with Zheng first and Xia second, breaking them one at a time: in the seventh month of the third year of Wude he ordered Li Shimin east with the army, took Cijian first, then nibbled away at the prefectures around Luoyang, cut the grain road and rested his troops on Mount Beimang; in the third month of the following year he closed in on Luoyang, dug trenches and built ramparts, and shut the Zheng troops inside the city. Dou Jiande could not sit still, and so led more than a hundred thousand men west, taking Zhouqiao, Guanzhou, Xingyang and Yangji on the way, though what he took were empty cities and ruined districts, and so he wasted his time. Li Shimin led a detachment of his own to Hulao, and the two armies stood facing each other for more than two months, the Xia army's supplies failing first and its morale breaking before anything was decided. Ling Jing, a professor of the imperial college, proposed a plan: cross the Yellow River, take Huizhou and Heyang, climb the Taihang and enter Shangdang, strike at Fenyang and Taiyuan and come down onto Puzhou, so as to enter empty country, to open new land for recruitment and to shake Guanzhong; the empress Cao agreed with him, but the other generals held that going deep was dangerous and blocked it, and Dou Jiande in the end did not act on it, and a northern offensive that might have changed the whole war died in the womb. When the Tang grain was nearly spent and the Xia army was pasturing its horses on the north bank of the river, Li Shimin crossed the Yellow River to Guangwu, left a thousand horses grazing on the bank to draw the enemy, and returned to Hulao by night; Dou Jiande took the bait, and his whole army came out from Banbu in a line twenty li wide, beating drums and giving battle. Li Shimin did not move, sending only a few men to engage and hold them, and at midday the Xia troops, hungry and weary and longing for home, sat down in ranks and crowded for water and fell into disorder; only then did the Tang strike, three thousand armoured riders charging straight into their camp, where Dou Jiande was still conferring with his ministers, the line collapsing at once, and the pursuit ran thirty li before he was taken. The Zheng garrison, for its part, had relied from the first on the bolt lines of Hulao Pass and the ramparts of Luoyang, and with the relief army gone and the grain road cut, the city was opened within a few months.
data: 本役可核的數字，諸史多有誇飾，只能取其大概。夏軍總兵力，資治通鑑與舊唐書以十餘萬、百萬之類的概況語形容，屬史筆的量級之語而非點驗名冊；竇建德西進所率既係大部，後文仍以十萬計。唐軍在虎牢的兵力，舊唐書稱李世民「親率步騎三千五百人趣武牢」，今人多疑其為唐初史臣神化之辭，實際應高於此數；決戰時投入的突擊兵力是三千鐵騎。戰場尺度方面，夏軍在板渚展開的正面寬達二十里，唐軍追奔三十里。戰果記夏軍被斬三千餘人、俘虜五萬餘人放歸；俘而縱之，是為瓦解其再戰之意，竇建德餘眾隨之星散。洛陽自武德三年七月出師至次年五月城破，圍城約十月；虎牢一線相持兩月有餘。地理上，板渚在滎陽北黃河南岸，與虎牢關隔水相望，洛陽城至虎牢關後世里程約五十餘公里，唐制約百餘里，正是這段距離讓唐軍得以在兩地之間調度。返京之後，竇建德以傳國八璽獻唐。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked for this campaign are much inflated in the histories, and only their rough sense can be taken. The total strength of the Xia army is described in the Comprehensive Mirror and the Old Book of Tang in terms of scale such as more than a hundred thousand or a million, which is the historian's way of indicating magnitude rather than a muster roll; the force Dou Jiande led west was already the greater part of his host, and later passages still reckon it at a hundred thousand. As for the Tang force at Hulao, the Old Book of Tang says that Li Shimin personally led three thousand five hundred foot and horse towards Hulao, and many today doubt the figure as a piece of flattery by the early Tang historiographers, holding the real number to have been higher; the shock force committed in the decisive action was three thousand armoured riders. As to the scale of the field, the Xia line deployed at Banbu was twenty li across the front, and the Tang pursuit ran thirty li. The results are recorded as more than three thousand of the Xia army killed and over fifty thousand prisoners taken and released; releasing them was meant to break their will to fight again, and Dou Jiande's remaining troops scattered accordingly. The siege of Luoyang ran from the march out in the seventh month of the third year of Wude to the fall of the city in the fifth month of the next, about ten months in all, while the opposing lines at Hulao stood for more than two months. Geographically, Banbu lay on the north bank of the Yellow River north of Xingyang, facing Hulao Pass across the water; the later mileage from the city of Luoyang to Hulao Pass is a little over fifty kilometres, some hundred-odd li by Tang measure, and it was precisely that distance which allowed the Tang army to move between the two places. On the return to the capital, Dou Jiande presented the Tang with the eight imperial seals.
cause: 戰起於隋末的天下大亂。李淵入關中而定關隴，一心要承隋室正統收拾群雄；但中原之權分作兩家：王世充先誅異己、控制洛陽，隋恭帝退位後進位為帝，改國號曰鄭；竇建德則在河北兼併群雄，進王位曰夏。兩家地盤相接而勢力相忌，李淵於是取先鄭後夏、各個擊破之策，先以李世民兵臨洛陽，斷其糧道、蠶食近州，逼王世充不得不向河北求救。竇建德接到求援時並非全無顧慮：洛陽若破，河北便要獨自面對唐軍，而河北雖廣，卻是四戰之地，經不起持久消耗；更關鍵的是，一旦唐廷盡有河南與河北，關中與中原便連成一體，他的地盤就再沒有縱深。於是他遣使與王世充修好，傾國來援。唐廷更深一層的算計則是：夏軍遠道而來，糧秣必然不繼，只要把時間拖成夏軍的消耗，這場救援本身便會變成夏軍的耗盡。於是有了北邙的圍城、有了虎牢的兩月相持、有了牧馬誘敵的那一夜。
causeEn: The war grew out of the collapse of the Sui and the wars that followed. Li Yuan had entered Guanzhong and settled the northwest, and his whole purpose was to inherit the legitimacy of the Sui and gather in the rival warlords; but the authority of the central plain was split between two houses. Wang Shichong had first destroyed his rivals and controlled Luoyang, and after Emperor Gong of Sui had stepped down he took the throne himself and changed the name of the state to Zheng; Dou Jiande had meanwhile swallowed up the other Hebei warlords and advanced to the title of Prince of Xia. The two territories touched and the two powers distrusted each other, and so Li Yuan adopted the policy of taking Zheng first and Xia second and breaking them one at a time: he sent Li Shimin against Luoyang, cut the grain road, nibbled away at the neighbouring prefectures and forced Wang Shichong to appeal to Hebei for help. When the appeal reached him, Dou Jiande was not without his misgivings: if Luoyang fell, Hebei would face the Tang army alone, and for all its breadth Hebei was a land fought over on every side and could not bear a long war of attrition; more decisively, once the Tang court held both Henan and Hebei, Guanzhong and the central plain would be joined into one, and his territory would have no depth left. He therefore sent envoys to renew relations with Wang Shichong and came to the rescue with the whole of his strength. The Tang court's calculation went one step further: the Xia army had come a long way and its provisions must fail, and if only time were turned into a drain upon the Xia army, the relief expedition itself would become the thing that exhausted Xia. Hence the siege on Beimang, hence the two months of stalemate at Hulao, hence the night on which horses were grazed to draw the enemy in.
impact: 這一役的結果，是隋末中原最後兩塊拼圖同時落下。唐廷平定洛陽與河北，中原歸於一統，關中、洛陽、河北自此連成一氣，貞觀之治所倚賴的財政、兵源與漕運通道都建立在這個基礎之上；劉黑闥在半年之內收復竇建德故地、終於武德六年被平定，則說明河北的整合並非一役可成，餘震長達三年。制度上，傳國八璽與隋代舊都洛陽歸唐，給新朝提供了名分與政統的合法性；王世充被貶為庶人、流放巴蜀，未幾為仇家子弟獨孤修德所殺，隋室宗支至此斷絕。人物上，李世民以一役擒獲兩家統帥，軍功無與倫比，高祖特設天策上將以賞之，秦王府的權力也隨之膨脹，兄弟相爭的種子就此埋下，日後的玄武門之變並非無緣無故。軍事上，本役提供了「斷糧—待疲—逸敵—騎兵直搗中軍」的完整樣板，被後世兵家反覆引述；器械上，虎牢關與洛陽城頭的弩列也再次說明，守方在隘口與城垣上把火力前置，遠比攻城方多花時間去強攻更為合算。
impactEn: The upshot of this campaign was that the last two pieces of the Sui-era central plain fell at once. The Tang court had settled Luoyang and Hebei, the middle plains were brought under a single rule, and Guanzhong, Luoyang and Hebei were joined into one; the finances, the manpower and the grain routes on which the reign of Zhenguan would rest were all built on that foundation. That Liu Heita recovered Dou Jiande's territory within half a year and was destroyed only in the sixth year of Wude shows that the integration of Hebei was not achieved in a single battle, and the aftershock ran for three years. In institutional terms the eight imperial seals and the old Sui capital of Luoyang came to the Tang, giving the new court the legitimacy of name and of succession; Wang Shichong was stripped of his titles, made a commoner and sent into exile in Bashu, and was shortly afterwards killed by a private enemy, the son of Dugu Ji, so that the Sui line of princes was extinguished. In personal terms, Li Shimin had taken the commanders of two states in one campaign, and his military renown stood without rival; Gaozu created the title of Heavenly General of the Heavenly Strategy to reward him, and the power of the Prince of Qin's establishment swelled with it, so that the seed of the fratricidal struggle between the brothers was planted here, and the later coup at Xuanwu Gate was not without cause. Militarily, the campaign supplied a complete model of cutting the grain road, waiting for the enemy to tire, drawing him out and driving horse straight into the middle of his command, a model quoted and re-quoted by later writers; in terms of equipment, the bolt lines of Hulao Pass and of the Luoyang ramparts showed once again that a defending force which pushes its fire forward at a defile and on the walls is served far better by that than the besieger is served by spending time on a direct assault.
result: 結果是唐軍全勝，鄭、夏兩家同時覆亡。板渚之戰中，竇建德十餘萬眾一日而崩，唐軍斬殺夏軍三千餘人，俘虜五萬餘人，縱之使歸；竇建德本人受傷被擒，檻車送洛陽城下與王世充相見，兩人相顧無言。王世充既見夏軍盡沒，遂獻洛陽降唐，隋室在中原的最後政權至此結束。唐軍主力回師洛陽，收其城邑、府庫與倉儲；七月，竇建德被送至長安處斬，王世充獲赦卻仍被貶為庶人、流放巴蜀，旋為獨孤修德所殺。夏的殘部由左僕射齊善行與曹皇后率百騎奔洺州，眾欲另立竇建德養子為王，齊善行排眾議，率百官奉傳國八璽降唐，河北的官署與府庫隨之歸入新朝。竇建德死後，舊部推劉黑闥為王，半年收復河北故地，武德六年李建成出師，才算徹底平定。虎牢一役至此把中原的格局重寫，關中、洛陽、河北從此歸於一朝，而這也正是唐朝走向貞觀的起點。
resultEn: The result was a complete Tang victory, with Zheng and Xia destroyed together. In the battle at Banbu Dou Jiande's host of more than a hundred thousand collapsed in a single day; the Tang killed over three thousand of the Xia and took more than fifty thousand prisoners, whom they released; Dou Jiande himself was wounded and taken, and was brought in a cage to the foot of Luoyang's walls to be confronted with Wang Shichong, the two of them looking at one another without a word. Seeing that the Xia army was utterly destroyed, Wang Shichong handed over Luoyang to the Tang, and the last Sui regime in the central plain came to an end. The main Tang force returned to Luoyang and took over its towns, its treasury and its granaries; in the seventh month Dou Jiande was carried to Chang'an and beheaded, while Wang Shichong was pardoned but was still stripped of his titles, made a commoner and exiled to Bashu, and was shortly killed by Dugu Xiude. The surviving Xia leaders, with the left prime minister Qi Shanxing and the empress Cao, rode a hundred horsemen back to Mingzhou; the troops wished to set up Dou Jiande's adopted son as king, but Qi Shanxing argued them out of it and led the hundred officials to surrender with the eight imperial seals, and the offices and treasuries of Hebei passed with them into the new dynasty. After Dou Jiande's death his old men set up Liu Heita as king, and in half a year he recovered Dou's former lands in Hebei; only when Li Jiancheng took the field in the sixth year of Wude was the thing completely settled. The battle at Hulao thus rewrote the map of the central plain, and Guanzhong, Luoyang and Hebei came under a single dynasty for good, and this was the starting point of the Tang road towards the reign of Zhenguan.
